prediction_scope: zero-projection at the four declared finite sizes only

contract.source: F4 = number of fully occupied elementary square faces
contract.source_parameter: equilibrium exp(t F4); t is per full face, no division by N
contract.observer: q=rank(H1 image)-1, E=q^2; U=N^(13/8)/2 * P4(E_p)/mean(q_p) at pooled q root
contract.N_seed_rule: splitmix64(master_seed XOR splitmix64(N XOR 0x5033333746345631)); passed to unchanged counter_permutation backend
contract.pairing: same permutation across both orientations and ordinary/forced modes within each replica; distinct seed domains across N
contract.forced_face: cyclic site labels {0,a,b,(a+b) mod N}; occupy all four, then activate remaining sites in induced permutation order
contract.inference: paired delete-one-batch root/slope-complete jackknife within N; independent covariance groups across N; all baselines from these fresh ordinary streams
contract.zero_projection_model: V_F4=0 at all four declared sizes; excludes an observable-level omission of the forced plaquette term
contract.stop_zero_model: reject if any simultaneous two-sided normal interval excludes 0; otherwise not excluded, not established
contract.stop_material_route: if all four simultaneous intervals lie inside [-0.5,0.5], stop prioritizing this source as a main coupling at this declared finite-scale resolution
contract.material_coordinate: a simultaneous interval wholly above +0.5 or below -0.5 resolves a material response in these declared units
contract.sign_prediction: none; the exact decimation map forces a term but not its sign
contract.unresolved_action: publish unresolved result and stop this fixed block; no sample top-up, no source or size substitution
nonclaims: rescue of failed P154 lag1 source
validation of old P334 contact forecasts

inference.estimator: full fresh block; paired root-complete delete-one-batch jackknife
inference.cross_N_dependence: independent seed groups; primary covariance block diagonal

metadata.counter_rule: batch*samples_per_batch+local; independent of threads and shard boundaries
metadata.semantics: One uniform permutation shared by both geometries and ordinary/forced modes. Forced occupies {0,a,b,a+b} first, then induces the free-site order from that permutation. Forward ambient rank>=1/rank2 birth counts use degree N or N-4; initial forced births may be0. Dense zero bins retained.
metadata.readout: q=r-1=-1+CDF(first)+CDF(second); E=q^2=1-CDF(first)+CDF(second). Each mode uses its own degree and count coordinate.
